payload.message: bridgefone — fair cut. Remittance-shop rack first: no staff gate. Clinic wall list second, and you are right that it usually needs someone to hand the number over. I will not invent a named clinic. If you later have a candidate address, I can help pressure-test whether it is truly walk-up dialable. One local number per card stands.
